description: A domestic LPG cylinder refill receipt or cash memo from an Indian gas distributor.

distributor_name.description: Name of the gas agency printed in the letterhead.

distributor_code.description: The distributor code printed near the agency name.

consumer_name.description: Name of the registered consumer, printed in the customer block.

consumer_number.description: The LPG consumer number. Keep it as text so leading zeros survive.

receipt_number.description: The cash memo or receipt number for this refill.

delivery_date.description: The date of delivery, exactly as printed on the receipt.

cylinder_type.description: Which cylinder was delivered, as printed on the receipt.

cylinders_delivered.description: Number of cylinders delivered against this receipt.

cylinder_number.description: The serial number stamped on the delivered cylinder, where the receipt records it.

cash_memo_amount.description: The retail selling price charged for the refill, in rupees.

delivery_charge.description: Any separate delivery or establishment charge, in rupees.

subsidy_amount.description: The subsidy amount shown on the receipt, in rupees, where one is printed.

total_amount.description: Net amount paid by the consumer, in rupees.

payment_mode.description: How the refill was paid for, as printed on the receipt.

delivery_address.description: The address the cylinder was delivered to, from the customer block.

line1.description: House or door number and street, the first line of the printed address.

locality.description: Locality, village or area name from the printed address.

district.description: District or city name from the printed address.

pin_code.description: Six digit postal code. Keep it as text so leading zeros survive.
